name_vi: Túi hở miệng quai vòng tròn
description_en: An open-top oval woven handbag with two large round cane handle rings integrated into the rim. Canonical front: a low curved woven wall beneath the round handle. Side view: an oval end wall with leather handle reinforcement. Rear view: the matching second circular handle above a plain woven panel. All panels, linings, hardware and inserts are completely unmarked; no text, logos, symbols or labels. Keep the identical structure, materials and attachments across all three views.
prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create ONE original photorealistic Vietnamese rattan/bamboo studio catalog product. Subject: An open-top oval woven handbag with two large round cane handle rings integrated into the rim. Canonical front: a low curved woven wall beneath the round handle. Side view: an oval end wall with leather handle reinforcement. Rear view: the matching second circular handle above a plain woven panel. All panels, linings, hardware and inserts are completely unmarked; no text, logos, symbols or labels. Keep the identical structure, materials and attachments across all three views.. Style Zen: calm minimal ornament and simple proportions. Relative size medium within its class, no measurements. Main woven surfaces: plain over-one-under-one basket weave. Finish: natural matte honey-tan fibers. Believable smooth bindings, continuous strips, stable wood/bamboo frame and only specified plain secondary materials. All interiors empty. CAMERA: exact straight-on FRONT ELEVATION at azimuth zero, directly facing its described front feature, level with product center. No three-quarter or overhead angle. This is the canonical FRONT image for subsequent views of the same design. Whole object visible, centered with generous margins. Plain warm-white seamless studio backdrop, soft lighting and subtle shadow, sharp fiber texture. Square image. No props, room, people, animals, food, plants, detached extra products, collage, diagram or border. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT ANYWHERE: no letters, numbers, words, symbols, labels, logos, captions, watermarks, measurements or inscriptions.
